description: This file defines token-related classes and constants used in a lexer/parser context, particularly for tokenization in a compiler or interpreter. It includes token type constants, a token interface, and a CommonToken class for token objects.

classes.name: TokenConst
classes.description: A class containing static constants representing token types and navigation types used in token streams.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: An interface representing a generic token, serving as a base for specific token implementations.

classes.name: CommonToken
classes.description: A class implementing the Token interface, representing a token with properties such as type, text, position, and methods for token creation and representation.

methods.name: forInput
methods.description: Creates a token with specified input, type, channel, start, and stop positions.

methods.name: forType
methods.description: Creates a token of a specific type.

methods.name: forTypeAndText
methods.description: Creates a token of a specific type with associated text.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the token's type.

methods.name: setLine
methods.description: Sets the line number of the token.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the token's text, either stored or extracted from input.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Overrides the token's text.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the token was found.

methods.name: getCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Returns character position within the line.

methods.name: setCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Sets the character position within the line.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel of the token.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description: Sets the channel of the token.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the token's type.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the start index of the token.

methods.name: setStartIndex
methods.description: Sets the start index of the token.

methods.name: getStopIndex
methods.description: Returns the stop index of the token.

methods.name: setStopIndex
methods.description: Sets the stop index of the token.

methods.name: getTokenIndex
methods.description: Returns the token's index in the token stream.

methods.name: setTokenIndex
methods.description: Sets the token's index.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns the input stream associated with the token.

methods.name: setInputStream
methods.description: Sets the input stream associated with the token.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: PHP magic method to return the string representation of the token.
